name: xhdr-live-bad: both X-group LIVE checks violated
description: The `region` argument is validly bound to X-Region (passes every static X-group check), but the live server accepts a call whose body argument disagrees with its header value instead of rejecting with -32020 (xhdr.param_mismatch_accepted), and separately rejects a call that omits the optional argument (and its header) with -32020 instead of allowing it (xhdr.absent_param_rejected).
